job.title: Senior Berater *in SAP CX FSM / CS / CM

tailoring.headline: Senior Berater SAP Commerce Cloud | Java, Spring & OCC REST APIs
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional SAP Commerce Cloud Consultant with 5+ years of experience delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, OCC REST APIs, data migrations, and integrations across PIM, ERP, and MDM systems. Proven track record in requirements analysis, process mapping, stakeholder management, and agile delivery. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Berater *in SAP CX FSM / CS / CM
cover_en.hook: Instaffo's commitment to connecting top talent with innovative digital projects makes this Senior Berater role an exciting opportunity. With over five years of hands-on experience designing and delivering enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep technical expertise combined with strong techno-functional consulting capabilities.

bullets.label: Requirements & Process Mapping
bullets.text: Acted in a techno-functional capacity with business stakeholders to analyse requirements, write user stories and functional specifications, and translate complex business needs into robust SAP Commerce solutions.

bullets.label: Enterprise Integrations
bullets.text: Designed and optimized PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines and investigated integration bottlenecks between SAP ERP, MDM, and Profisee platforms while working alongside international technical teams.

bullets.label: API & Headless Delivery
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services and headless APIs, engineering custom Interceptors, Populators, and Converters to support seamless data flows.

bullets.label: Stakeholder Collaboration
bullets.text: Gathered and analysed business requirements directly with product owners and business teams, mapping processes and supporting user acceptance testing across agile delivery cycles.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, and I am available to start on 16 December 2026. I welcome the opportunity to discuss how my expertise can drive value for Instaffo and your clients.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Senior Berater *in SAP CX FSM / CS / CM
cover_de.hook: Instaffo überzeugt durch exzellente Vermittlung und spannende technologische Projekte, weshalb mich die Position als Senior Berater *in besonders reizt. Mit über fünf Jahren fundierter Praxiserfahrung in der Implementierung und Weiterentwicklung von SAP Commerce Cloud Plattformen bei Rockwell Automation und Shell verbinde ich tiefes technisches Know-how mit starker techno-funktionaler Beratungskompetenz.

bullets.label: Anforderungsanalyse & Prozessdesign
bullets.text: Ich agierte in einer techno-funktionalen Rolle mit Business-Stakeholdern, analysierte Anforderungen, verfasste User Stories und übersetzte diese in passgenaue SAP Commerce Lösungen.

bullets.label: Komplexe Integrationen
bullets.text: Ich konzipierte und optimierte Datapipelines zwischen PIM, SAP ERP, MDM und Profisee und löste Integrationsengpässe in enger Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Teams.

bullets.label: API-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Ich entwickelte und bereitete OCC REST Web Services sowie Headless-APIs vor und passte Interceptors, Populators und Converters für reibungslose Datenflüsse an.

bullets.label: Agile Zusammenarbeit
bullets.text: Ich ermittelte und analysierte Geschäftsanforderungen gemeinsam mit Product Ownern und Fachabteilungen, bildete Prozesse ab und begleitete erfolgreiche Abnahmetests.

cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, verfüge über eine unbeschränkte Arbeitserlaubnis und befinde mich in einer regulären Kündigungsfrist mit letztem Arbeitstag am 15.12.2026. Mein frühester Eintrittstermin ist der 16.12.2026. Ich freue mich sehr auf ein persönliches Gespräch.

tailoring.why_company: Instaffo stands out through its modern approach to matching top-tier talent with ambitious enterprise projects. I am eager to bring my 5+ years of techno-functional SAP Commerce expertise, stakeholder management skills, and enterprise integration experience to help deliver exceptional value for your clients.
tailoring.motivation_short: Bringing 5+ years of SAP Commerce expertise, strong techno-functional consulting skills, and robust enterprise integration experience to drive success at Instaffo.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I bring 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience, strong techno-functional consulting skills, and enterprise integration expertise from Rockwell & Shell. Based in Germany with a valid work permit, I'm available from Dec 16, 2026. Let's connect regarding the Senior Berater role!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior Berater *in SAP CX FSM / CS / CM – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my application for the Senior Berater *in SAP CX FSM / CS / CM position at Instaffo. With over 5 years of professional experience building enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud solutions, strong techno-functional consulting capabilities, and deep integration expertise gained at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-positioned to contribute effectively to your projects.

My CV and cover letter are attached. I look forward to discussing my profile with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
